met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough aloft in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 78°E to the north of Lat. 28°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east Telangana & adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh persists and now lies at 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Assam & adjoining Bangladesh now lies over east Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough in easterlies now runs from Southeast Arabian Sea adjoining Kerala to South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A fresh Western Disturbance likely to affect northwestern Himalayan region from 10th November.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Sub-Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
